data_label: Source data documented as synthetic (dummy) in the Data Context & Relationship Diagram; not operational performance.
simulated_label: SIMULATED under stated assumptions. Not observed. Inputs unverified.
assumptions: S-01 undated Stock assumed to apply on day 0
S-02 no open orders or backorders on day 0
S-03 Min and Max read as reorder level and order-up-to level, unverified (D-02)
S-05 backorder reference, lost sales alternative
S-11 issues stand in for demand; they are not proven demand
P-05 promised interval stands in for lead time; it is not a goods-receipt lead time
D-03 evidence thresholds 6 active months and 10 lead observations
D-05 service levels 90, 95, 98 percent are scenario levels
D-24 proposed parameters for the 228 Grade A materials only
